page.title: EBSD Pattern Indexing
page.subtitle: Dictionary, Hough, and Spherical indexing with pixel selection and chemistry-based filtering

methods.houghTip: Fast, standard method — detects Kikuchi bands via Hough transform
methods.dictionaryTip: High accuracy — matches patterns against a pre-simulated dictionary
methods.sphericalTip: CPU-based spherical indexing via EMSphinx (uses harmonic transforms, requires WSL)
methods.embeddingTip: Experimental — uses a trained neural network for fast indexing

spherical.backendTip: GPU (in-process PyTorch) is ~11x faster than EMSphInx CPU on identical data and produces bit-identical orientations. Falls back to CPU automatically when no CUDA is detected.
spherical.bandwidthTip: Spherical harmonic bandwidth. Higher = more accurate but slower. 88 is a good default.
spherical.regionsTip: Number of regions for adaptive histogram equalization
spherical.refineTip: Enable refinement for more accurate orientation results
spherical.gaussianBgTip: Subtract a 2D Gaussian background from each pattern
spherical.circularMaskTip: Apply a circular mask to each pattern.
spherical.customRadiusTip: Custom circular mask radius in pixels
spherical.cpuFallback: No NVIDIA GPU detected — spherical will run on the CPU. Same results, but far slower.
spherical.cpuFallbackWithEstimate: No NVIDIA GPU detected — spherical will run on the CPU. Same results, but roughly {{estimate}} for {{n}} patterns (minutes on a GPU).
spherical.cpuConfirmBody: Spherical indexing will run on the CPU. Results are identical to the GPU path, but it is far slower. Start anyway?
spherical.cpuConfirmBodyWithEstimate: Spherical indexing will run on the CPU. Results are identical to the GPU path, but for {{n}} patterns expect roughly {{estimate}} instead of a few minutes on a GPU. The estimate is rough — a laptop CPU can be several times slower. Start anyway?

matchesDialog.title: Dictionary Indexing — Pattern Match Quality
matchesDialog.clickHint: Click a pixel in the NCC map to inspect that pattern match.
matchesDialog.orientationHoughTip: This is a cubic-approximant phase (point group m-3): the spherical SO(3) correlation lands on a wrong pseudo-symmetric variant, so the orientation comes from Hough band-geometry indexing instead. The score map (CI) is still from spherical.
matchesDialog.tryVariantsTip: If the simulated pattern doesn't match, show candidate orientations (current + crystallographic pseudo-variants + Hough), each rendered with its match score. Pick the one that matches and apply it to the whole grain. Works for any phase.
matchesDialog.variantsHint: Pick the variant whose simulated pattern matches the experimental one ({{pg}}). R = render match (higher = better). Then apply it to the grain.
matchesDialog.applyGrainTip: Flood-fill the grain (connected, same phase) and flip every pixel to ITS own matching variant — intra-grain distortions are preserved and variant-split grains are fixed in one apply.
matchesDialog.exportTip: Open the publication figure export composer
matchesDialog.suspicionHint: This match looks wrong — try the pseudo-symmetry variants.
matchesDialog.refineTip: After the flip, polish each pixel's orientation with a guarded Newton refinement. It is automatically discarded if a render-match spot check shows no improvement.
matchesDialog.undoTip: Restore the orientations changed by the last apply (one level).
matchesDialog.currentNoop: 'current' is the orientation already on the map — pick a different variant.
matchesDialog.refPickTip: Add any indexed pixel's stored orientation to the gallery as a candidate (rendered + scored like the others). Use this when the correctly-indexed grain does NOT touch the wrong one — for touching grains the neighbour-grain candidates appear automatically.
matchesDialog.applyAllTip: Fix the clicked grain AND every other grain map-wide with the same phase and the same wrong orientation. Each sibling is adopted only if its own render-NCC clearly improves — genuinely different small grains stay untouched. One Undo restores everything.
matchesDialog.propagateDone: Map scan: {{found}} similar grains → {{adopted}} adopted (render-verified), {{rejected}} rejected — {{px}} px.
matchesDialog.propagateNone: Map scan: no other grains with this orientation found.
matchesDialog.propagateTruncated: (capped at 32 grains — run again for the rest)
matchesDialog.nudgeTip: Nudge by 1 px (arrow keys work too)
matchesDialog.reindexTip: Run a fresh full orientation search for this pixel's own phase and add the result as a candidate. Covers pixels where variants, Hough and neighbour grains all fail. First click per result takes ~6 s (backend warmup), then fast.
matchesDialog.nudgeClickTip: Click a cell to jump the selection there (arrow keys nudge by 1 px)
matchesDialog.zoomLayerTip: Choose which map the lens shows: IPF direction (Z/Y/X) or phase colours
matchesDialog.suspicionHintRefine: Same orientation to within {{delta}}° — this needs sub-degree refinement, not a variant flip. Use “Re-index this pixel” and apply it to the grain.
matchesDialog.pickHint: Click a pixel, or drag the crosshair. Zoomed in, dragging moves the image — hold Shift to drag the crosshair.

phaseTest.title: Single-Pixel Phase Test
phaseTest.clickScan: Click the scan to pick a pixel ({{rows}}×{{cols}}):
phaseTest.scanUnknown: Scan area unknown — use the index input below.
phaseTest.edsAtTooltip: EDS atomic-% at the active pixel ({{row}}, {{col}})
phaseTest.qualityTip: Higher = sharper simulated bands (better discrimination), slower. Lower = faster.
phaseTest.bgRemoveTip: Remove the dynamic background from the measured pattern before comparison (matches the clean simulated pattern → better R/discrimination).
phaseTest.usePixelPcTip: OFF (default): use the map-mean PC for the simulated geometry — clicking through pixels is instant (no rebuild). ON: use the exact PC of the clicked pixel — more accurate geometry, but rebuilds the phase models each click (slower). Phase ranking is robust either way; turn ON for a precise single-pixel check.
phaseTest.buildingHint: (first run builds the models, ~20–30s; later pixels are instant)
phaseTest.orientationHoughTip: This is a cubic-approximant phase (point group m-3): the spherical SO(3) correlation lands on a wrong pseudo-symmetric variant, so the orientation (and the rendered pattern) come from Hough band-geometry indexing instead.
phaseTest.useForIndexingTip: Add this phase to the indexing list for {{method}} and switch the indexing method to it.
phaseTest.methodUnavailable: This phase has no file for {{method}} — generate one first (CIF→Hough, SHT→Spherical, master .h5→Dictionary).
phaseTest.exportTip: Open the publication figure export composer
